text:
deploy-bot: rollout v2026.03.23 completed. starting post-deploy synth smoke for /ws/* routes. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/3901237890
Priya: seeing 502/503 in the long-poll probe for /ws/notifications in eu-west1, small spike at 09:04UTC. anyone else?
ops-bot: synth-report: ws-notify-check -> 503 on 4 hosts (eu-west1) - backend-reset. retry scheduled.
Oscar: i'm on-call for eu-west1. checking node logs, noticing kube termination events around the same times. could be session affinity metadata loss during pod recycle.
Priya: prefer a targeted pin rather than a full rollback. can we route traffic for /ws/notifications to v2026.03.21 in eu-west1 while we triage?
deploy-bot: executing: redwood route pin --route /ws/notifications --to v2026.03.21 --region eu-west1
deploy-bot: pin applied, 100% traffic to v2026.03.21 in eu-west1.
QA Lead: toggled feature flag stickySession=false on v2026.03.23 variant and kicked off smoke rerun.
ops-bot: synth-run id ss-3901237890-2 completed: 200/200 health checks OK, p95 37ms, no 5xx observed.
Priya: great. leaving pin in place for 25m to collect distributed traces and client-side error budgets.
Oscar: filing follow-up ticket INF-9901 "sticky-session metadata flush on terminate" and attaching traces/logs. will push a graceful-terminate delay tomorrow.
deploy-bot: rollout hold set. notifying #deploy-notify.
Priya: plan to re-enable stickySession with a 10% canary after the hold if metrics stay green. thanks team.
